description: Angular component for configuring Azure IoT Hub settings within a rule node, including form setup, validation, and configuration processing.

classes.name: AzureIotHubConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent for Azure IoT Hub configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and returns the configuration object for output, adjusting credentials if type is 'sas'.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form fields that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates validators for credential fields based on selected credential type.
